name: Base Image EOL Lint - Dockerfile and CI end-of-life check
subtitle: Marks every base image in your Dockerfiles, compose files and CI workflows whose security patches have already stopped - or stop before 13 November 2026 - and prints the tag that replaces it.
free: Checks the file you have open against all 21 rules and shows every out-of-support image with the tag that replaces it and how long it has been unpatched - no key, no limit, no watermark.
paid: Scans every Dockerfile, compose file and workflow in the repository at once, writes a dated CSV/JSON/HTML report, and prints machine-readable output so CI fails the build before an unpatched base image ships.
need_key: This option needs a licence (Base Image EOL Lint - Dockerfile and CI end-of-life check).
